functions.description: Extract timestamp, host, process PID, and message body from raw ESX Cmmdstimemachine log line
Extract witness/registered node IP address when present in message (e.g. witness node registration)
Derive severity level from message keyword prefix
Normalize action field based on message content patterns

add.name: action
add.value: message.match(/successfully persisted|completed successfully|checkpoint created|registered/) ? 'success' : message.match(/Failed to acquire|Checksum mismatch|Unauthorized write|denied/) ? 'failure' : message.match(/Rollback initiated|Quarantining|pruning/) ? 'remediation' : message.match(/latency exceeded|clock skew|Disk space check/) ? 'warning' : message.match(/transition detected|restarted/) ? 'state_change' : 'informational'

functions.description: Set static protocol/component identifiers for this ESX time machine log source
